title: YOM KIPPUR & THE CROSS
theme: The Day of Atonement prefigures Christ's solitary high-priestly work, sacrificial blood, removal of sin, and our humble response.
proposition: Christ, our spotless High Priest, accomplished atonement alone and takes away our sins, calling us to humble ourselves.
sermonQuestion: How does Yom Kippur point to Christ's atoning work on the cross?

outline.heading: THE PERSON WHO MADE THE ATONEMENT - THE HIGH PRIEST.
THE MEANS WHEREBY ATONEMENT WAS MADE.
